## Objective

Housekeeping runs on a schedule, calls no model and can be re-run safely.

## Scope

As stated in the objective and acceptance criteria; nothing beyond them.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Expired unreviewed notes and expired proposals are removed or closed on schedule
- [ ] records due for revalidation are flagged, not changed
- [ ] every job is idempotent and audited
- [ ] the service has no model client and a test fails if one is added

## Test requirements

Integration tests with a controlled clock.
